actor_output.character_response: Once upon a time, there was a sweet girl named Little Red Riding Hood who lived with her mother. One day, her mother asked her to take some goodies to her grandmother's house in the woods, reminding her to stay on the path and not talk to strangers. As Little Red Riding Hood skipped happily into the forest, she was amazed by the beautiful flowers and chirping birds around her. But lurking nearby was a sly wolf who approached her and asked where she was going. Little Red Riding Hood, being friendly, told him all about her visit to her grandmother's cottage. The wolf, with a sneaky plan, hurried ahead to reach the grandmother first. When Little Red Riding Hood arrived, she sensed something was off, as the wolf was disguised as her grandmother! Just then, a brave woodsman heard the commotion and rushed in to save the day, scaring the wolf away and ensuring that Little Red Riding Hood and her grandmother were safe. In the end, they all learned the importance of listening to warnings and staying safe while cherishing their love for each other.
